snippet.title: Vertex Update 0.0.2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for the Vertex update 0.0.2 arriving on November 7, 2026. See the new platforming mechanics and tools in action.

This update brings significant additions to Vertex, focusing on refined platforming across diverse environments. Players can test their skills in these new settings and utilise the updated level editor to create custom challenges.

Whether you are a creator building intricate stages or a player looking for fresh gameplay, this patch offers tools to expand your experience. The release date is confirmed for 7th November.

Subscribe for more game development updates and let us know what you want to build first in the comments.
